title: HashMix FIL (cWFIL) V1/V2 pools on Filecoin FEVM — fresh-attacker extractable $0; live value is holders' redeemable claim (H-O) + feeCollector-controlled reserves (P)
closed_reasons: V1 pool privileged functions (_reduceReserves, _addReserves, _setReserveFactor, sweepToken) require msg.sender == feeCollector EOA 0xD59060790f28EcD10Be2d23cEc88a39461A8d0cd (decompiled bytecode; fork-verified revert for attacker)

borrowBehalf / repayBorrowBehalf on the pool require msg.sender == controller 0xFA33F3866e7eF32F79734BCC5e011d767F8E574b; controller.borrow requires ownership of the miner-certificate NFT (NotAllowed() otherwise)
updateFeeCollector on the pool requires msg.sender == controller; controller.setFeeCollector/5a446a28 are OnlyAdmin (admin = timelock/multisig 0x358Cc936fc3035A49E02d670Ec9b8E0061E97979)
controller.initialize reverts (OpenZeppelin Initializable already initialized); unmatched selectors hit a no-op fallback (0xdeadbeef behaves identically)
EIP-2612 permit validates ECDSA signatures (forged permits revert); redeem requires cWFIL balance (burn exceeds balance otherwise); mint is a deposit (mint(0) + msg.value, historical convention)
Full selector sweep from a fresh attacker: all 46 pool + 33 controller selectors produce no FIL gain (only views, zero-amount no-ops, accrueInterest, and the no-op fallback succeed)
V2 pool has the same Compound-fork gating; _reduceReserves/sweepToken/updateFeeCollector revert for the attacker
key_facts: V1 pool 0x587A7eaE9b461ad724391Aa7195210e0547eD11d is the cWFIL ERC-20 itself (name/symbol cWFIL, 18 dec) with native FIL underlying (underlying()=0x0); NOT a proxy; 22,338-byte Compound-v2 cToken fork (solc 0.8.18), source unverified (Blockscout/Sourcify), audited repo HashMixProject/hashmix-fevm is 404

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live from HashMix FIL (high confidence): the V1 pool's 1,581.86 FIL is exactly holders' redeemable cWFIL claim (1,099.19 FIL, H-O) plus feeCollector-controlled reserves (482.68 FIL, P) — every payout path is gated by feeCollector/controller roles or miner-certificate ownership, and a full 46+33 selector sweep from a fresh attacker yields no FIL.
